tie_reference: TIE (2026). English for Secondary Schools Student's Book Form 1. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.
source_note: Verified English Form One schemes of work (Arusha Catholic Seminary) for Term I and Term II. 5 periods per week (2 x 80-min double periods + 1 x 40-min single period). Term I covers Chapters 1-6 (main competences 1.0-3.0); Term II covers oral comprehension, responding, oral communication and text creation (main competences 4.0-5.0) plus review, mock assessment, FTNA revision and annual examinations. Weeks for mid-term assessments carry no specific teaching activity.
